notes.title: LOG : 3 weeks since the release
notes.notes:
It’s been 3 weeks since Recompile release. After more than 2 years of development, we are pleased to see that the atmosphere, the graphics and the story of the game please you so much.

Thanks to you reviews on Steam and our social networks, we were able to make the necessary changes improving your gaming experience on Recompile. However, we are still looking for new reviews to perfect our game, in order to erase the negative point impacting your gameplay and your in-game experience. And equally identify the game aspects you enjoyed in purpose to improve the development of our following games.

notes.title: Patch notes for Aug 26th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/be480e2214f03f4f790a6268db83b5f5a41fcec6.jpg[/img]
We've just updated the game with an incremental patch. Based on community feedback, we've fixed/added the following :-

- Adjusted maximum upwards aiming angle, you're now able to aim significantly higher than before
- Added a new Audio tab to the options menu, allowing adjustment of music and SFX volume
- Tweaked lighting and colors on the Quantum Cores and Batteries in the OKT areas, making them easier to see if they've been activated or not.

These are relatively minor/quick fixes, but please be assured we are also tackling bigger issues and features for future patches. Thank you for supporting the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Aug 21
notes.notes: - Fixed critical softblock bug where backtracking to Install without certain abilities means you can't get back to the portal. Have re-enabled the original Installation button for players to escape.

notes.title: Update Notes for 20th Aug
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/be480e2214f03f4f790a6268db83b5f5a41fcec6.jpg[/img]

[u]New Features[/u]
- Added options for camera sensitivity and smoothing for both regular gameplay and aiming.
- Added option to disable controller vibration.
- Added option to invert X axis.
- Added option to change aiming technique curve from Dual Zone to Linear.
- Arrow keys can now switch tabs on the Pause/Options screen.

[u]Fixes[/u]
- Fixed various minor localization issues
- Fixed various minor dynamic music issues in all biomes

notes.title: Recompile Release : 19 august
notes.notes:
[h1]Immerse yourself in the cybernetic world of Recompile this 19th August 2021.
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=R2RibvIAFSo;full][/previewyoutube]

You are The Program, a semi-sapient computer virus created by the enigmatic Janus, on a mission to infiltrate and repair the Mainframe. A 3D virtual world living inside a decades long abandoned computer system, the Mainframe is a hostile environment to all external code.

The task will not be an easy one, for deep within the hidden subroutines exist an entity known only as the Hypervisor, an artificial intelligence turned corrupt after mysterious events.
Put the pieces together, solve the mystery of the Mainframe, and the discover the events that lead to humanity's greatest accomplishment.

Fight, hack and explore. Use every tool to perform your mission, your programming depends on it!

[h2]OTHER NEWS[/h2]

We've updated our key artwork and logo! 

Which one do you prefer?
